human_friendly_tldr: In the selected fixed-weight neural network, near-edge phases can retain an earlier input for several cycles, but a second input interferes with the fixed linear readout. Across the 16 reused primary phases at 4T, near-edge accuracy is62.8989% without a second write and55.0540% with it, versus50.0077% at the core. Benefits vary strongly by phase; nonlinear recoverability and geometry-specific utility remain open.
